Certificates.Title: General harmonic multiplier and spectral positivity
Scope: Nine symbolic parameter identities for the logarithmic multiplier, Jacobi coefficient, spectral certificate and threshold.
52 finite exact cross-checks for elementary-symmetric pairings, root derivations and Newton expansions in orders 2 through 5.
These do not replace arbitrary-order inequality proofs, actual-image arguments, singular-set removability, or geometric comparison.

Certificates.Title: Normed products and complex Pfaffian models
Scope: Exact symbolic elementary-symmetric pairings in degrees 2 through 5 and a complete real-coordinate order-4 Pfaffian normalization.
Fixed-seed exact integer samples for H/O words in degrees 2 through 6, two samples per case and left/right/balanced bracketings.
Fixed-seed exact complex-integer samples for Pfaffian matrices of orders 4, 6 and 8, two samples per order.
Most of the 6015 recorded checks are scalar components of these finite coordinate calculations; this number is not a count of independent theorems or an all-degree symbolic proof.
The accompanying 62-check Wolfram script covers a different, smaller subset and has not been executed here.

Certificates.Title: Weighted Clifford quartic certificate
Scope: Formal differential-algebra identities for the specified three-generator table and G=WF.
Exact coefficient positivity conditional on R>0, W>0, and R^2-4W>=0; boundary coefficient beta>=40 and Hardy arithmetic 385/4.
Does not establish the original-variable closure table, actual-image inequalities, geometric singular-set description, or global area comparison.

Certificates.Title: Three-weight quartic subcalibration criterion
Scope: Exact symbolic consequences of the general three-weight differential table, including both potential defects and the ambient-weight correction.
Exact interval and coefficient certificates for h>=12, h=10,11, and balanced h=8 with r0>=5; both boundary Jacobi coefficients and the common Hardy arithmetic.
Conditional algebraic checks do not establish Euclidean realizability, weight integrality, actual-image bounds, singular geometry, removability, or the global comparison theorem.

Certificates.Title: Cartan reduction and refined subcalibration bounds
Scope: Conditional exact identities for the intrinsic cubic table and Cartan reconstruction.
Exact h=9 quartic discriminant, ambient-weight correction, degree-eight endpoint values, and the 21 finite low-unused-weight exclusions.
Spectral dimension and Hardy arithmetic; the Newton inequality, classifications, image realization, geometric comparison and strictness proofs are in the manuscript.

Certificates.Title: Odd/even gradient-square closure and intrinsic geometry
Scope: The manuscript states only the closure and regular-link identities. Further Hessian-rank, curvature, distance-density, Jacobi and stability calculations remain supplementary computations, not additional results asserted in this manuscript. The same rule applies to the omitted sextic Hopf interpretation.

Certificates.Title: Quadratic compositions, rectangular quartics and Gram sextics
Scope: Exact formal orthogonal-quartic, rectangular-trace and Hermitian-Gram identities conditional on the differential tables proved in the manuscript.

The H^2 and C^2 coordinate identities are symbolic identities in fixed finite dimensions. The rectangular coordinate tests use three explicit integer matrices for each p=3,4,5,6 and one critical matrix in M_{5,3}(R).
The radial Clifford checks use one homogeneous cubic profile and one quadratic profile and do not establish the formula in arbitrary degree.
Strict positivity checks assume the stated nonnegative shifted variables and manuscript parameter ranges.
Additional Hopf, critical-Hessian and algebraic initial-form identities are cross-checks only and do not assert additional manuscript theorems.
No check proves classification, realizability, irreducibility, removability, global minimization, noncongruence, or tangent-current convergence.
